name: Berea College
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts work college with 30+ fields of study; described as the most selective institution in Kentucky. 2025 recognition includes #1 Best College for Tuition and Tax Dollars (Washington Monthly), and U.S. News rankings of #5 in Social Mobility, #1 in service-learning, and #2 Most Innovative Schools.
financial_aid: Berea College is tuition-free and has not charged tuition since 1892. Every admitted student receives a full-tuition scholarship (Berea Tuition Promise); the college also assists with housing and meals per FAFSA. Students typically come from low-income families (avg family income under $32,000/yr). Additional support includes a professional clothing stipend and internship funding. As an NCAA D3 institution, no athletic scholarships are offered.
facilities_notes: Softball plays at Berea College's on-campus softball facility. Detailed facility specifications were not publicly listed on the softball program pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Heartland Collegiate Athletic Conference. Small roster (13 players in 2026). As a D3 program, no athletic aid is awarded; recruiting emphasis aligns with Berea's tuition-free, work-college mission.
notes: Softball staff directory (bereaathletics.com/sports/softball/coaches) checked 2026-07; only two staff listed (head coach and one assistant). Conference confirmed on athletics roster/staff pages as Heartland Collegiate Athletic Conference. Team X/Twitter handle listed as @BereaSoftball; no individual coach social handles published. Tuition confirmed as $0 via berea.edu (tuition-free since 1892).
